title: Her Little Plant
lines: Pam and her sister have a little plant.
They set her pot on the top step.
Then a big pig runs past and bumps it.
The pot lands under the step in the mud.
Pam fills her pot back up with her hands.
The plant flops. It will not stand up.
Then Pam pats the mud in hard.
Her plant sits up at last.
But that pig will run past this step.
So Pam and her sister lift the pot up.
Her plant sits safe in the yard corner.

questions.ask: What knocked the pot off the step?
questions.listenFor: A big pig that ran past. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: What did Pam do to get the plant to stand up?
questions.listenFor: She patted the mud in hard. If they say "she filled the pot," ask "did the plant stand up then?"

questions.ask: Why do you think they put the plant in the yard corner?
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The pig runs past the step, and the story says so.
